aboutBlock.title: About us
aboutBlock.p1: HackChain is an educational-professional ecosystem that connects Talent, Educators, and Recruiters to promote constant learning and transparency in recruitment processes.
aboutBlock.p2: We believe Web3 technology should be accessible, decentralized, and designed to empower real users. Our goal is to support professionals in their growth with immutable tools and credentials that truly make a difference.
aboutBlock.p3: Our vision is to become the global standard for talent verification, creating a world where every acquired skill is recognized worldwide without barriers or intermediaries, effectively closing the gap between education and employment.

items.question: What is HackChain?
items.answer: HackChain is an educational-professional ecosystem that connects Talent, Educators, and Recruiters to promote constant learning and transparency in recruitment processes.

items.question: What is a tokenized certificate?
items.answer: A tokenized certificate is an NFT that holds all the information of a traditional certificate. This NFT is immutable, non-transferable, unforgeable, and can only be owned by one person — one Talent.

items.question: What benefits do I get by signing up as Talent?
items.answer: You'll own a portfolio of certificates you can share at any time, and you'll have access to a wide range of courses, lectures, and more from Educators across different fields of knowledge.

items.question: What benefits do I get by signing up as Educator?
items.answer: Educators can issue certificates to any Talent within the ecosystem quickly, and get their educational material in front of them.

items.question: What benefits do I get by signing up as Recruiter?
items.answer: As a Recruiter, you can view every Talent within HackChain and the certificates they hold, so you can strategically offer a job opening to the best candidate.
